profile.headline: Software Developer | .NET | Azure | Angular | Active Clearance
profile.summary:
I am a U.S. Air Force veteran turned software developer, blending 10+ years of leadership with hands on experience in .NET, Azure, Power Platform tools, and SharePoint. At Trewon Technologies, I contributed to building secure, scalable tools that streamline compliance, enhance intranet systems, and empower federal teams to make smarter decisions with data. 

My transition into tech wasn't just a career pivot, I tackled it as a mission shift. I bring military discipline to agile development, while taking requirements and turning them into high-impact solutions. Whether it's optimizing internal or client systems, I focus on outcomes: faster processes, cleaner data, and better user experiences.

I thrive in fast-paced environments where precision matters and collaboration drives results, even in the unknown. If you're looking for someone who can bridge strategy and execution, whether in code, compliance, or cross-functional teamwork...let’s connect.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I modernized multiple legacy applications and improved development workflows at CSS Federal.  

• Reconfigured Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, achieving seamless production deployments with zero downtime.  
• Engineered automated end-to-end testing using Cypress, saving over 15 hours of manual testing per sprint.  
• Co-designed a standardized VM image, cutting developer onboarding time by 75%.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Upgraded and deployed a checklist application using .NET/C# and Azure services for authentication, data storage, streamlining security compliance for a 300+ member federal department.
• Partnered with system owners and product managers in an Agile setting, leading sprint planning sessions and retrospectives, reducing development team delivery by 20%.
• Developed and managed a departmental SharePoint intranet site collection with five subsites and over 30 pages, supporting a 40-member section including a communication site for a 76,000-employee audience. 
• Built Power BI reports to provide actionable insights on 58 cloud systems, increased report usage among federal staff by 70% and reduced system analysis time by 40%.
• Deployed Power Automate and Power Apps to automate team notifications, SharePoint data entry and validation, cutting errors by 53% and processing time by 50%.
positions.insights: SharePoint Development, Microsoft Power Platform and +7 skills

positions.title: Microsoft Software & Systems Academy: Cloud Application Development
positions.description:
• Automated package monitoring for team project, ensuring currency and security; integrated a team chat bot to deliver timely notifications, enhancing project efficiency and collaboration. 
• Developed and tested applications using the .NET framework, C#, and object-oriented programming principles to enhance application maintainability, flexibility, and scalability.
• Created a mortgage calculator using C# and Object-Oriented programming that accurately calculates payments and generates amortization schedules based on customer data. 
• Employed GitHub secrets and Azure Key Vault to fortify the protection of critical backend services, ensuring source code security and confidentiality.

positions.title: Aircraft Maintenance Manager
positions.description:

• Leveraged SharePoint to create, manage, and showcase an employee training tracker and mentorship program, resulting in a 27-day reduction in the average training time for new members.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
positions.description:
• Managed SharePoint sites and lists for incident reporting, data analysis, safety, maintenance inspections, and training, contributing to enhanced operational capabilities and workflow of a 4000-member organization. 
• Organized a critical aircraft Weight & Balance technical meeting, resulting in procedural changes that enhanced worldwide safety of flight.

projects.title: GameStack
projects.description:
I am currently working on GameStack, a modern Angular + ASP.NET Core application that integrates Steam OpenID (more soon!) for secure authentication and Azure SQL for game and user data. The frontend includes a responsive UI, state management, and routing to support user profiles and game libraries. On the backend, I designed scalable APIs with session handling, security, and data management to ensure a seamless experience for players building and organizing their game collections.

Key features:
- Steam authentication with session tracking
- Game library import with tagging, searching, and filtering
- Modular architecture for maintainability and future expansion
- Game progress and achievement tacking
- Cloud sync for seamless access across devices

I'm having a lot of fun with this project and its building on my passion for creating meaningful, user-friendly applications.

projects.title: Algorithm Visualizer | github.com/eMantonya
projects.description:
This program is an algorithm visualizer built with Blazor. It allows users to interactively see how different sorting algorithms work, complete with animations and UI updates.

- Includes multiple sorting algorithms
- Dynamic array generation
- Real-Time Visualization
